description: The literal lists, limits and sentences contracts/procedures/v1/procedure.py applies to a procedure (E105a). Any change to a list or a sentence changes rules_version; the same rules_version gives the same verdict wherever the validator runs.

sentences.valid: Valid: {label}, version {version}. It reads {reads} and makes {makes}.
sentences.not-json: Not valid: procedure.json is not readable JSON.
sentences.not-object: Not valid: {where} must be written as a JSON object.
sentences.unknown-field: Not valid: {where} has a field Ophiolite does not know; check its spelling.
sentences.digest-field: Not valid: Ophiolite works out the code's fingerprint itself; remove it from procedure.json.
sentences.missing-field: Not valid: {where} is missing a required field.
sentences.wrong-schema: Not valid: procedure.json must say it is an Ophiolite procedure, version 1.
sentences.bad-name: Not valid: the procedure's technical name may use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
sentences.unreadable-label: Not valid: {where} needs a readable label, for example "Depth shift".
sentences.engineering-word: Not valid: {where} uses a word meant for technical details; describe it in everyday words.
sentences.bad-version: Not valid: the version must be a whole number from 1 to 1000000.
sentences.bad-step: Not valid: the step must be one of read, source, process, send or check.
sentences.bad-text: Not valid: {where} has a text that is empty, too long or not plain text.
sentences.bad-list: Not valid: {where} must be a list within its limit.
sentences.bad-identifier: Not valid: {where} needs a technical name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
sentences.duplicate-identifier: Not valid: {where} repeats a technical name used earlier.
sentences.wrong-input-class: Not valid: {where} is not an input this step can read.
sentences.wrong-input-count: Not valid: this step reads a different number of inputs.
sentences.wrong-output-class: Not valid: {where} is not something this step can make.
sentences.wrong-output-count: Not valid: this step makes a different number of outputs.
sentences.kind-not-allowed: Not valid: {where} names a type of data this step cannot use.
sentences.bad-cardinality: Not valid: {where} must say whether it takes one item or many.
sentences.bad-signature: Not valid: {where} needs file extensions such as ".las", text the file starts with, and how many bytes to look at (at most 65536).
sentences.regex-pattern: Not valid: {where} gives a pattern that is not plain text; patterns are literal text, optionally starting with ^.
sentences.secret-in-label: Not valid: {where} must name the system in words, without an address or credentials.
sentences.bad-type: Not valid: {where} needs a type: number, integer, text, choice or yes/no.
sentences.bad-unit: Not valid: {where} has a unit Ophiolite does not list; leave the unit out when it is unknown.
sentences.bad-bounds: Not valid: {where} has limits that are not numbers in order.
sentences.bad-default: Not valid: {where} has a default value that does not fit it.
sentences.bad-choices: Not valid: {where} needs at least two choices, each with a distinct value and a readable label.
sentences.bad-entry: Not valid: the entry must name a Python file of this folder and a function in it, as module:function.
sentences.missing-file: Not valid: the entry names a Python file that is not in this folder.
sentences.no-manifest: Not valid: this folder has no procedure.json.
sentences.bad-member: Not valid: this folder holds something that is not a plain text file, or a name Ophiolite does not accept.
sentences.not-text: Not valid: every file of a procedure must be UTF-8 text.
sentences.too-many-files: Not valid: a procedure may hold at most 200 files.
sentences.too-large: Not valid: a procedure may hold at most 1 MiB of files.
sentences.bad-destination: Not unpacked: the destination must be a new or empty folder.
sentences.bad-archive: Not unpacked: the archive is not a procedure archive Ophiolite accepts.
